text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All right...! Is everyone ready?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O's original 'Ultimate Obstacle 
Training'! We'll definitely see it through 
to the end!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Ooooh~♪

As for why Sakura Chiyono O ended up 
designing and leading the training... That 
story begins a few days ago—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't stay as I am now... I have to put 
in more effort and train harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Unless I pile up heaps of effort... I'll 
never be able to ignite the fire in 
Maruzen-san's heart...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please let me do some special training! 
Something so tough no one's ever tried it 
before... I'll even come up with the plan 
myself!!

Unable to dismiss her enthusiasm, I agreed 
to the new training regimen she had 
devised.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san, Laurel-san! To think both 
of you would help out too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! If anyone is in trouble, I'll dash 
right to their side! That is my duty as 
Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I already know what your dream is, 
Chiyo-chan. If there's anything I can do, 
please just tell me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And so, based on the concept of "anything 
but ordinary training," I want to build an 
obstacle course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
First is the Tarzan course! You leap from 
rope to rope to move forward! What do you 
think? Pretty intense, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It also strengthens your upper body, huh! 
Yeah, sounds good to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Heave... ho... there we go. Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the ropes are all set up! Now... 
let's give it a test run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I need... a quick 
breather...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, already?! We've only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe the course is just a bit too 
grueling.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true... I just thought it had to 
be a hardcore course, and got carried 
away...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Right now I have to train 
hard and put in tons of effort! "It ain't 
over till the ref raises the fan!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"The next training is cliff climbing! It's 
perfect for building up the upper body, 
you know!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just climbing a cliff... It's 
while carrying a log on your back!
choice_data_list:
Just climbing the cliff is tough enough, 
and now...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It certainly seems like great training, 
but... checking for safety first is just 
as important.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is my cue! I'll demonstrate its 
safety with an exemplary climb!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
B-Baku-chan...!? Hold on a second, let me 
put a lifeline harness on you. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Look at this speed! A log is nothing to 
me—with this, carrying 100 of them would 
be a breeze!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—Mm? Is that a strange sound coming from 
beneath my feet...?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is bad, the scaffolding is 
collapsing! Could the logs be too heavy... 
or something!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaaaaa--!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! Putting you in such danger 
because of me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, don't worry about it! Thanks to 
the safety rope, I'm right as rain, as you 
can see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...All I do is fail. I guess it was 
unreasonable after all..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I can't let myself get 
discouraged... I have to become stronger 
than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Please make sure to watch 
over Chiyo-chan, okay?
choice_data_list: Are you worried about Chiyono O after all?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You look a little anxious. ...That's just 
how desperate you are, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's figure out the next 
training session! If I want to compete 
with Maruzen-san, I have to work much, 
much harder!
